source_scope.authoritative_document: ODS语兴好物（y shopping）电商数据表.md
source_scope.source_detail_limit: All 23 overview assets have same-name detailed DDL. DDL and sample rows still disagree in quality operation, quality result and outbound columns; sorting states that only the latest record is retained; operator DDL has a trailing comma. Definition coverage therefore does not prove executable schema, history completeness or production data.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name DDL plus explicit Warehouse, Inventory, WMS operation, quality, Identity, Catalog, AI evidence and publication boundaries with source-drift corrections.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production full-denominator reconciliation with exact tenant, owner, Catalog SKU, Warehouse/Location, Lot/UOM, operation/result, Principal, AI application/workflow/model/policy versions and immutable decision/effect lineage.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Warehouse master/configuration publishes versions; receipt, sorting, quality, identification, shipment, AI invocation, review, decision, feedback and publication observations append immutably.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Deletion retires current visibility only; it never erases physical-operation, inventory-ledger, quality, model, policy, decision or restricted-evidence lineage.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant, owner, Catalog SKU/SPU, Warehouse/Zone/Location, nullable Lot, base UOM, Principal/operator/vendor group, operation/result/taxonomy and AI application/workflow/model/policy identities; quarantine unknown mappings and source-shape conflicts.

receipt_line.grain: one immutable physical receipt-line observation for an exact source item/quantity and destination Warehouse
receipt_line.identity: receipt line/header, shipment, source seller/Merchant, Catalog SKU/SPU, P-code, Warehouse/Location and Lot remain qualified distinct identities
receipt_line.money_or_quantity: quantity uses explicit base UOM and decimal precision; receipt observation never becomes on-hand, reserved, in-transit or available balance
receipt_line.history: receipt, carrier and shelf-status changes append with event time and source version
receipt_line.security: waybill and sender references are restricted operational evidence
receipt_line.authority: Warehouse/WMS owns physical receipt evidence; Inventory alone accepts the stock movement and owns balances/ledger

receipt_header.grain: one immutable advance-shipment/receipt-header version with one-to-many receipt lines
receipt_header.identity: dispatch bill, receipt, waybill, personal seller, Merchant and receiving Warehouse identities remain separate
receipt_header.money_or_quantity: header never supplies item quantity or Inventory balance
receipt_header.history: dispatch, appointment, carrier, cancellation and receipt changes publish versions
receipt_header.security: sender name, nickname, address, remarks and waybill are restricted
receipt_header.authority: Warehouse/WMS owns appointment and receipt header; Identity/Merchant and Fulfillment own referenced parties and shipment

warehouse_operation.grain: one immutable execution attempt/result at exact task, item, Warehouse/Location, operator and time
warehouse_operation.identity: task/result, P-code, Catalog SKU/SPU, owner, Warehouse/Location, station/line and Principal remain distinct
warehouse_operation.money_or_quantity: planned and operated quantities require base UOM; work counts never mutate Inventory balances directly
warehouse_operation.history: every retry, assignment, completion, correction and deletion/void appends; latest-only source snapshots are incomplete history
warehouse_operation.security: operator names and remarks are restricted operational evidence
warehouse_operation.authority: WMS owns physical work execution; Inventory owns accepted movement ledger and Quality owns accepted decisions

quality_decision.grain: one immutable inspection or identification decision for exact task/item/evidence and policy version
quality_decision.identity: quality task/result, P-code, receipt line, Catalog item, Warehouse, reviewer Principal, reason/policy and AI evidence remain distinct
quality_decision.money_or_quantity: scores/counts require scale and units; decision does not itself change stock status, saleability or refund
quality_decision.history: initial, recheck, override, revoke and human acceptance append without overwriting prior decisions
quality_decision.security: images, free-text reasons, actor names and item evidence are restricted
quality_decision.authority: Quality owns decision; Inventory changes quality/stock state only through an explicit accepted command

quality_taxonomy.grain: one immutable quality-reason taxonomy node/version with applicability and category scope
quality_taxonomy.identity: source reason id, canonical node/version and Catalog category mapping remain separate
quality_taxonomy.money_or_quantity: no monetary or inventory quantity authority
quality_taxonomy.history: label, hierarchy, applicability and scope changes publish versions; deletion retires future use
quality_taxonomy.security: reason content is governed taxonomy content and must not absorb personal evidence
quality_taxonomy.authority: Quality owns taxonomy; each decision freezes the exact node/version

shipment_handoff.grain: one immutable outbound handoff/status observation for exact source shipment and operator
shipment_handoff.identity: outbound, business Order/Fulfillment, carrier shipment, waybill, Warehouse and Principal identities remain distinct
shipment_handoff.money_or_quantity: a header without item lines cannot prove shipped quantity or Inventory decrement
shipment_handoff.history: pick, pack, handoff, carrier transit, delivery and correction observations append
shipment_handoff.security: waybill and operator display data are restricted
shipment_handoff.authority: Warehouse/WMS owns handoff evidence; Fulfillment owns delivery state and Inventory owns shipped ledger movement

warehouse_master.grain: one tenant-scoped canonical Warehouse version with stable identity and source mappings
warehouse_master.identity: source id/code and canonical Warehouse id remain mapped rather than equated; Zone and Location are separate children
warehouse_master.money_or_quantity: no stock quantity is stored on Warehouse master
warehouse_master.history: name, lifecycle and mappings publish versions; retirement cannot rewrite past operations
warehouse_master.security: creator/modifier display data maps to restricted Principal audit evidence
warehouse_master.authority: Warehouse Network owns Warehouse/Zone/Location identity and lifecycle

workforce_assignment.grain: one versioned Warehouse workforce/vendor-group assignment for a canonical Principal
workforce_assignment.identity: source worker, Principal, credential, vendor group, Warehouse assignment, shift and compensation terms remain separate
workforce_assignment.money_or_quantity: salary requires currency, pay period and effective interval; attendance targets are workforce policy, not operation facts
workforce_assignment.history: vendor, shift, attendance, pay and active-state changes publish effective-dated versions
workforce_assignment.security: names, pay and attendance are highly restricted; credentials are never migrated
workforce_assignment.authority: Identity owns Principal; Workforce owns employment/pay; Warehouse owns operational assignment

ai_case.grain: one immutable identification request/case version bound to exact requester, item, evidence requirements and service policy
ai_case.identity: identify/request, user, Order, Catalog SKU/SPU/product, category/brand, payment and AI workflow identities remain distinct
ai_case.money_or_quantity: fee requires currency and Payment reference; image count is a typed requirement, not evidence completion
ai_case.history: submit, process, finish, fail and cancel append with application/workflow/policy versions
ai_case.security: user, Order, risk tags and required evidence are restricted
ai_case.authority: Quality owns the case and accepted result; AI Operations owns invocation evidence; Payment owns fee settlement

image_evidence.grain: one immutable image-object version for exact identification case, item part and uploader
image_evidence.identity: image, secure object blob, identify case, user, Catalog item and part taxonomy identities remain distinct
image_evidence.money_or_quantity: dimensions and bytes are typed media metadata, never business quantity
image_evidence.history: upload, scan, quality check, redact, supersede and retire append; mutable URL cannot replace history
image_evidence.security: raw URL/image and hashes are restricted; canonical events expose secure object token, digest, media type and scan state
image_evidence.authority: secure storage owns bytes; Quality owns evidence linkage; AI result remains advisory

ai_observation.grain: one immutable AI quality/feature/authenticity observation for exact invocation, image/case and model version
ai_observation.identity: task, invocation, provider request, case, image/feature, application/workflow and model versions remain distinct
ai_observation.money_or_quantity: confidence/score require scale and calibration; latency uses milliseconds; none authorizes stock, refund, pass or reject effects
ai_observation.history: attempt, result, timeout, alternative outcome and error append; retries preserve provider and payload digests
ai_observation.security: images, features, risk factors and raw model payloads remain restricted
ai_observation.authority: AI Operations owns invocation/observation; Quality or Risk owns accepted human/business decision

human_review.grain: one immutable human review decision against exact AI result and evidence window
human_review.identity: review, case, AI task, expert Principal, operations group, policy and accepted decision remain distinct
human_review.money_or_quantity: confidence requires declared scale; review does not directly mutate Inventory or payment
human_review.history: assignment, start, completion, cancellation, dispute and superseding review append
human_review.security: expert identity, issue reasons and evidence are restricted
human_review.authority: Quality owns human review and accepted decision; AI observation is not self-authorizing

report_projection.grain: one versioned report/publication projection from an accepted Quality decision
report_projection.identity: report, post, template, case, accepted decision and public asset remain distinct
report_projection.money_or_quantity: share count is an analytical counter, not source authority
report_projection.history: render, publish, fail, withdraw, correct and share observations append
report_projection.security: public report is separately redacted; restricted case/image evidence never leaks through URL or title
report_projection.authority: Quality owns accepted result; Content/Engagement owns publication projection

feedback.grain: one immutable feedback/complaint observation linked to exact case/report/image and author context
feedback.identity: feedback, case, image, report, Principal and remediation/review identities remain distinct
feedback.money_or_quantity: no refund, compensation or model-training quantity is inferred
feedback.history: submission, triage, resolution and model-label acceptance append
feedback.security: content and image URL are restricted evidence and require secure-object mapping
feedback.authority: Quality owns feedback workflow; model retraining and customer remedy require separate governed decisions

policy_config.grain: one immutable effective-dated product-support or rule-policy version
policy_config.identity: configuration/rule/version, Catalog product/category/brand, AI application/workflow/model, template and operator group identities remain separate
policy_config.money_or_quantity: threshold/sample rate require range, scale and version; no fee or inventory authority
policy_config.history: draft, approve, activate, supersede, expire and rollback publish versions
policy_config.security: risk expressions and callback configuration are restricted control-plane data
policy_config.authority: Quality/Risk owns policy; Catalog owns product/category/brand; AI Operations owns executable workflow/model versions

model_version.grain: one immutable AI model artifact/version plus independently governed deployment assignment
model_version.identity: model artifact/version, application, workflow, deployment, Catalog scope and owner Principal remain distinct
model_version.money_or_quantity: training/evaluation metrics require denominator, dataset/version and scale; they do not prove production quality
model_version.history: register, evaluate, approve, gray, promote, rollback and retire append
model_version.security: artifact, dataset lineage and owner data are restricted control-plane evidence
model_version.authority: AI Operations owns model registry/deployment evidence; Quality owns acceptance policy

model_lifecycle.grain: one immutable lifecycle/observation event for exact model deployment and scoped Catalog item
model_lifecycle.identity: lifecycle event, model version, deployment, workflow, Catalog scope, metric snapshot and operator Principal remain distinct
model_lifecycle.money_or_quantity: observe days and metrics require exact window/denominator; success is not business acceptance
model_lifecycle.history: request, train, online, observe, sample, offline and re-online events append
model_lifecycle.security: metric snapshot and operator display data are restricted
model_lifecycle.authority: AI Operations owns deployment lifecycle; Quality/Risk owns business admission and rollback criteria

rule_decision.grain: one immutable rule-engine decision for exact case, AI task, rule/policy version and input evidence digest
rule_decision.identity: decision, case, AI task, rule/version, template and accepted human/business decision remain distinct
rule_decision.money_or_quantity: threshold/sample rate require scale and policy version; action is advisory until owning-domain acceptance
rule_decision.history: matched rules, action, callback, override and downstream acceptance append
rule_decision.security: matched rules, reasons and risk inputs are restricted decision evidence
rule_decision.authority: Rule engine owns computed decision evidence; Quality/Risk owns accepted decision and downstream effect
